steps.action: PPE on: lab coat, gloves, eye protection. Wash in.
steps.check: All PPE on before approaching the bench.
steps.if_wrong: No PPE, no bench. Restart the step.

steps.action: At the bench, check every container is sealed and labelled.
steps.check: Each container checked; any unlabelled container set aside, never used.
steps.if_wrong: Nothing unlabelled is used. Set it aside.

steps.action: Check the cold store temperature log on the door.
steps.check: Log read; any gap in the log noted.
steps.if_wrong: A gap in the log is a finding, not a detail. Note it.

steps.action: At the plan board, read the therapy plan steps and name the check after each step.
steps.if_wrong: A step without a check is a step unguarded. Name the check.

simulations.label: SIMULATION — practice only. Not a licence, not a certification, not a credential, not a diagnosis, not advice for any real person, site or deal.
simulations.scenario: Run a practice governance vote: proposal, discussion, vote, minutes.

scoring.notes: Practice votes only. Nothing decided here moves funds or changes any real record.
scoring.pass: All steps in order, every check passed. Practice score only — it certifies nothing.

steps.action: Read the proposal on the proposal board, including the arguments against it.
steps.check: Proposal read; at least one argument against noted.
steps.if_wrong: A proposal read without its objections is half-read. Read both sides.

steps.action: Discuss: one question asked, one answer heard.
steps.check: Question asked and answered before voting.
steps.if_wrong: Voting before discussion is not governance. Discuss first.

steps.action: Cast a practice vote at a voting terminal.
steps.check: Vote cast; the vote is practice only — no on-chain effect.
steps.if_wrong: Say it aloud: this vote moves nothing real. Then vote.

steps.action: Write the minutes: proposal, vote, outcome, one line each.
steps.if_wrong: A vote without minutes is a vote forgotten. Write them.

sources: Anchor: lat -38.71260348427612, lon -27.248278366617797. Status anchored = real-world anchor coordinate exists; rp1 null, NOT live on RP1.
Fabric: 36 nodes total (scene root + 20 top-level + nested Agent/Swarm children); 12 distinct GLB refs, all unhosted — see missing_models.

Districts/buildings = the real 'Zone · ...' nodes. NPCs = the real 'Agent · ...' nodes (nested under their zones; NPC position = zone position + the agent node's local offset) plus all three real 'Advisor · ...' nodes (Host Advisor, Steward Liaison, Alignment Advisor; top-level fabric positions through the world transform). The 'Steward seat 1–3 · human' nodes are human seats, not game characters, and are not NPCs. All NPC dialogue is original game dialogue, never attributed to a real person.
Biome 'forest' is a design choice for this interpretation.
Agent companions are game characters representing the real Virtuals agents (agents.json); their live instances are offline — not live connections.
Zones (6): Personalized Therapy Lab, DAO Governance Hall, Multi-Blockchain Ledger, Healthcare Data Exchange, Biopharma AGI Agents Hub, Steward Council.
Note: the W3 April 2026 internal series list has no Biota series number — Biota is anchored here by its fabric, not by a series slot.
